'''Ratch''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Scavenger/Legends|scavenger]]. He was a captain of his [[GS-100 salvage ship/Legends|GS-100 salvage ship]] [[Raider (salvage freighter)/Legends|''Raider'']].

==Biography==
[[File:RatchCarriesVentress-Nightsisters.png|thumb|left|200px|Ratch lifts a wounded Ventress from her fighter]]
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], after the [[Battle of Sullust/Legends|Battle]] of the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]], Ratch and his [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] crew retrieved an unconscious [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] within her damaged [[Ginivex-class starfighter/Legends|''Ginivex''-class starfighter]] from the debris. She asked them to take her to [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]], and when they wouldn't, they were all [[Death/Legends|killed]] by her.
